about_the_game:
The winds of change are blowing over the city, where every burger is a challenge, and every day is a battle for your place in the fast-food world. In Burger Takeout, you and your team take on the challenge of managing a burger restaurant, striving to please every customer, maintain cleanliness and efficiency in the kitchen, and skillfully manage finances in a tough market.

Burger Takeout gives you the opportunity to dive into the daily life of the restaurant business, where success is measured not by expansion, but by the ability to adapt and survive. Here you will find a unique balance between striving for perfection in preparing burgers and the need to manage resources with limited supplies.

Develop your own strategy and ensure smooth teamwork to exceed customer expectations and effectively respond to market changes. Burger Takeout requires from you not only culinary skills but also flexibility, entrepreneurship, and the ability to make quick decisions.

Join the dynamic world of Burger Takeout, where each new day offers unique challenges and opportunities for growth. Here, every burger you serve and every satisfied customer brings you closer to recognition in this challenging industry. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the restaurant business, demonstrating that your burger is more than just food; it is a masterpiece.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 780 Ti или AMD Radeon HD 7970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: Нет
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Ryzen 5-2600 | Intel i5-8400
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050TI
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: Нет

short_description: Burger Takeout - a cooperative fast-food simulator. Manage a burger joint, balancing between orders and inventory supplies. For success, raise your rating and keep an eye on finances, adapting to the market. Strategy and teamwork will be significant assets in this dynamic gameplay.
